system.description:
Also, at 3rd level, you learn to manifest a powerful barrier of chakra. Whenever you complete a short or long rest, you create a Chakra Barrier, amplifying yourself with it.

| #### Chakra Barrier / Unique Amp / You have a special barrier with its own hit points that always intercepts damage you would take until the barrier itself has no more hit points remaining. It shares and resistances or immunities you have. / Your barrier has a number of hit points equal to twice your level, and its hit points cannot exceed that value. / You gain a Rank of Mastery to Chakra Control Checks. This increases to 2 Ranks of mastery at 9th level and 3 ranks at 17th level. / Your barrier can regain hit points by doing one of the following; / Transferring Temporary hit points, you have to it, granting it 1 hit point for every 1 temporary hit point you transfer. / Sacrifice the DR (Damage Reduction) you would gain from jutsu, granting it 2 hit points for every 1 DR you sacrifice. / While your barrier has 0 hit points, you lose the benefits of this Amp. |
